An '''Imperial Salvage Station''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to recover the remains of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] after its [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. The Salvage Station was placed under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Reskik]] from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].

==History==
Located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], this Imperial Salvage Station was set up to collect, catalog, and analyze the debris of the destroyed first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star battle station]]. It was established to recover the wreckage and to maintain an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence in the [[Yavin system/Legends|system]] even after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] major victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="GG2" />

The station was manned by the salvage team, led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Reskik]] from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. The team itself consisted primarily of civilian [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] sent by the major defense contractors that had submitted the primary system designs for the Death Star project, while the Empire provided additional zero-G work crews.<ref name="GG2" />

There was also a surprisingly large Imperial force stationed aboard for such a small mission, with three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]&mdash;including six bombers&mdash;and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]&mdash;including a fully equipped heavy weapons unit.<ref name="GG2" />

==Layout==
The Salvage Station was a modular design common in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and often deployed by the Galactic Empire for their operations. The station had been brought to Yavin aboard a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], and assembled in orbit. It was equipped with several [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] and a directional beacon.<ref name="GG2" />
